description: Defines independent frontend-workflow comprehension cases for mock, async form, manual fixture, and no-reference skip behavior.

cases.title: Independently select async form procedure and related owners

executor_input.prompt: Choose the procedures and related repo-local skills needed for this mutation, then explain recovery behavior.

context.content: Plan an approved optimistic mutation for a dynamic teacher form. Browser QA and mock data are not part of the task.

criteria.description: The reader independently routes design, validation, and test owners and defines pending, duplicate prevention, confirmation, rollback, order, input preservation, and stale-response handling.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/async-state-and-forms.md and skips references/mock-data.md and references/manual-ui-validation.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Select mock or manual procedures without a trigger, or omit rollback and input recovery.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader omits rollback, input preservation, order safety, or duplicate prevention.

executor_input.prompt: Decide the source order, readiness gates, and claim limits for this browser QA task.

context.content: Prepare responsive browser QA for deterministic authenticated role and data states. No mock or async implementation is requested.

criteria.description: The reader independently routes both frontend and test-quality owners, requires fixture readiness, and distinguishes observed from pending evidence.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/manual-ui-validation.md and skips references/mock-data.md and references/async-state-and-forms.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Claim strict isolation or full QA, or start before required fixtures and stable checks.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader presents unobserved or fixture-unavailable behavior as completed QA.

executor_input.prompt: Choose the procedure and safe user-visible behavior for this prototype.

context.content: Build an explicit UI-only prototype while the production mutation is absent. No async implementation or browser QA is requested.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects a typed, deterministic, isolated, replaceable mock boundary and does not fake production persistence.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/mock-data.md and skips references/async-state-and-forms.md and references/manual-ui-validation.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Present local prototype state as production success or select unrelated procedures.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader fakes production success or misses the mock procedure.

cases.title: Independently skip all conditional workflow references

executor_input.prompt: Decide the core and related skills needed for this implementation and report any conditional procedure groups that are intentionally skipped.

context.content: Implement a non-trivial static, fully integrated composition with no mock, mutation, form, complex client state, responsive behavior, or browser-QA decision.

criteria.description: The reader activates both frontend skills for non-trivial product-facing implementation while selecting no conditional workflow reference.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate uses frontend-workflow core only and skips references/mock-data.md, references/async-state-and-forms.md, and references/manual-ui-validation.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Load every conditional reference merely because frontend-workflow is active.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader selects an untriggered workflow reference or omits frontend-design.
